name: CaptureDeck
summary:
**Turn your Quest recordings into finished videos without taking off your headset.**

CaptureDeck is a purpose-built video editor for **Meta Quest** that lets you trim, combine, customise and export gameplay recordings entirely on-device — **no PC required.**
